title: Polaris Key error-code registry (conformance/parity/errors.json)
description: Every error code the Worker or an SDK emits, with its kind, owning service and meaning (PARITY §2.1 'Same failures'). Hand-written; tools/gen-sdk-constants.ts validates it against this schema, checks it against the codes the Worker's source emits, and generates every SDK's ErrorCode constants from it.

code.description: The exact string a host matches on. Wire codes are snake_case; client codes are mostly kebab-case. Recorded as they are: renaming one is a behaviour change.

kind.description: `wire`: appears in a Worker response body. `client`: raised only by an SDK.

service.description: The service whose behaviour the code reports, or `core` for the always-on substrate.

description.description: One sentence: what happened. Rendered on reference/error-codes.
